items.label: 2.4G wireless connection,No Lag
items.value: Enjoy a seamless wireless experience with the USB receiver; 2-in-1 nano receiver, no need to install other software, this wireless keyboard and mouse set features an endearing lovely theme with cute icons and a soft color scheme. The keys on the top are in a love pattern, which adds a romantic color and a new element to work, and a good mood for every day's work and life

items.label: Retro Floating Round Keycaps
items.value: Colorful keyboard and mouse wireless with vintage typewriter-inspired retro floating rounded keycaps, gives you the most comfortable typing experience and adds some much needed spunk to your desk; the crisp key sound takes you back to the industrial era, and the independent round keycaps facilitate finger positioning; the floating keys under your fingertips are comfortable and skin-friendly

items.label: Auto Sleep Mode, Long Battery Life
items.value: Both the wireless keyboard and mouse combo feature independent power switches and an auto sleep mode that activates after 30 Mins of inactivity; wake them up with a simple double-click on any key; the keyboard requires 1 AA battery while the mouse requires 1 AA battery, and 2 AA batteries included

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: The keyboard is designed with a tilt angle that promotes a comfortable typing position; the wireless mouse features a sweat-resistant and skin-friendly finish, with a contoured shape that allows for hours of comfortable work

items.label: 13 Multimedia Hot Keys
items.value: Incorporating 13 hotkeys and a numeric keypad, this wireless keyboard elevates efficiency and productivity in work and study environments; its stunning design and robust functionality are bound to win your affection

items.label: Wide Compatibility & Great Service
items.value: Wireless keyboard compatible with Windows 2000 / ME / XP / 7 / 8 / 10, VISTA and Mac; wireless ergonomic keyboard, suitable for desktops, Chrome-book, PC, Laptop, Compute and more

items.label: 104 Keys Full Size Wireless Keyboard And Slient Mouse
items.value: Due to the silent micro-motion technology, the mouse clicks are nearly silent, eliminating bothersome knocking sounds that could disturb you and your family; the cordless mouse features multiple DPI levels (1600) for fast and precise cursor control, all while maintaining a quiet operation; whether you're working or playing, you'll never have to worry about disturbing others' rest

items.value: All Windows Server Versions 2001, Chrome OS, Linux, Mac OS, iOS
